new_test_correction.reason: The fixture is one readable widget in a valid 800x600 layout. Its existing Waiting label describes source availability; it does not degrade layout. SP-W09-SCENE-SURFACE retains degraded status for degraded layouts, not absent telemetry. The new test incorrectly predicted degraded. Correct to exact ready for both raw and prepared inputs, retaining literal Waiting text and exact native pixel equality. No original acceptance gate or product state selection changes.

qualification: Prepared snapshot contracts and selected development regressions pass, including the seven unchanged ordinary GUI timing/erasure cases after the measured repair. W-11 and all five complete releases remain open.
limitations: Diagnostic spans isolate construction costs; they do not establish the cause of every prior GUI delay or replace ordinary qualification.

The new native state expectation was corrected against the existing layout contract, with both failed attempts and original frozen test preserved. No original GUI threshold, stimulus or output changed.
Positive native policy remains an unprivileged compiled fixture. No protected deployment, signing or publication occurred.
Installed image/topology, maximum-input inspector performance, human accessibility and desktop/lifecycle composition remain required.
Development host tests do not qualify historical Windows execution. Complete Windows 9x, Windows NT, Linux X11, Wayland and Mac OS X releases remain unqualified.
Raw evidence archives are local ignored artifacts; fresh checkouts run declared commands in admitted environments.
next: Continue W-11 installed image/topology and maximum-input inspector qualification, then desktop/lifecycle composition, retaining all five release tracks and existing independent host experiments.
